message.content: In one of the discussions, Briar suggests adding "quick one-twos" to the practice session to keep stamina up. While specific types of passes are not explicitly mentioned, the term "one-twos" typically refers to short passing combinations where a player passes the ball to a teammate, who immediately passes it back, creating a quick exchange of control. This type of pass is beneficial for maintaining a high tempo during the practice session and keeping players engaged and active.
